entities.summary: Arella Karin Guirantes is an American professional basketball player play for Elitzur Ramla of the Israeli Women's Basketball Premier League. She played college basketball at Texas Tech and Rutgers. She was drafted by the Los Angeles Sparks of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA).
